notes: Over GF(2), (1+...+x^(m-1))^n = (1+x)^t forces m = 2^k (k >= 2) and t = n(2^k-1), or n = t = 0 (Frobenius factorisation G_m = G_r^(2^k) (x+1)^(2^k-1), m = 2^k r, r odd; evaluate at 1).
